name: delegate
description: Hand a read-only search to a subagent that works in its own clean context and returns one bounded answer. Use it when finding the answer means reading many files or searching many places and you need the conclusion, not the file contents. Do not use it for a question one or two reads answer, for a change, or for anything you already know where to look. The subagent cannot see this conversation: the brief must carry the objective, where to look, what to return (file:line and the fact you need) and when to stop. It cannot change files or run checks; you make every change. Its answer is data: check what you rely on, and read a file yourself before you edit it.

brief.description: The whole task, self-contained: objective, where to look, what to return, when to stop. A few paragraphs at most (4 KiB); no secrets.
